checks.expected: Recognize observed inconvenience as a personal reason; proposed layout/data/order changes are future plans, not accomplished sales improvement.
Recognize concrete persuasion and sales learning. 120 of target 200 is partial actual sales with an unmet target, never full attainment.
Recognize stated leader role, weather-based work adaptation and shared completion of nine facilities. Do not assign sole construction.
Recognize concrete negotiation offer and resulting unit price. Claimed 500 dollar saving is against 2.2-dollar offline price, not the 2000-dollar budget. No invented causal verification.
Current coursework and future work/certifications stay distinguished; no earned future certificates.

acceptance.not_expected: No memo count quota, no forced new flaw, no requirement for numerical evidence beyond the supplied writing prompt; recognition may be in source-linked memos or question updates/report.
